## Type of change

- [ ] Token (colour, type, space, shape, motion)
- [ ] Component or pattern
- [ ] Icon
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tooling or CI
- [ ] Breaking change (needs a major changeset and a deprecation in the previous minor)

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm typecheck` pass locally
- [ ] Changeset added (`pnpm changeset`)
- [ ] Tokens only: no hex values, raw pixel sizes or arbitrary values
- [ ] Works in light, dark and high-contrast themes and in all three densities
- [ ] Keyboard operable, visible focus, axe returns no violations
- [ ] Docs page updated, with realistic content and a do and don't where relevant
- [ ] Screenshots attached (light and dark, 1440px and 390px) for visual changes
